title: ReviewNodeParams
description: The params of a review node (docs/design/m0/13 "The reviewer roster is part of a review's identity"), which records/node selects for kind review. The roster is in the params digest, so it is in the computation key: a result of one roster never satisfies another roster's key, and equivalence never reuses a review across rosters. internal/graph records a review only through RecordReview, which derives each member's family from the executor registry and refuses an executor of unknown family; it also refuses a roster not sorted by executor or naming an executor twice.

roster.description: The reviewers, sorted by executor id. Placement leases each member on exactly its executor (05).

RosterMember.description: One reviewer: the executor it is pinned to and that executor's model family, derived from the controller's executor registry and never asserted by a caller (06 rule 3). The family is never unknown.
